# SimHub Component - Build, Architecture & Telemetry Specification

Build, architecture, and telemetry protocol specification for the G-Rebels SimHub plugin.

Technical protocol specification: [Reakktor Official Telemetry Info](https://reakktor.com/htm/gr_telemetry.htm).

---

## 1. Scope & Protocol Architecture

* **Expanded Layout Only (264-Byte Payload)**: The plugin decodes the full 29-channel telemetry payload generated by G-Rebels when configured to **Expanded** telemetry mode.
* **Sim Racing Studio (SRS) Mode vs Expanded Mode**:
  * In G-Rebels, the telemetry output defaults to **Sim Racing Studio** (SRS). The SRS mode only transmits 11 basic motion and orientation channels, omitting all combat, weapon, vital, thruster, boost, and impact normal vectors.
  * To receive the full combat simulation feed, users must switch the telemetry output profile to **Expanded** in the game's menu.
* **JSON-Configured Field Map**: Packet offsets, types, and property bindings are declared in `SimHub.GRebels.json`, compiled at startup into a zero-allocation map.

## 3. Official Expanded Field Map (264 Bytes)

All decimal byte offsets into the UDP payload:

| Field | Type | Offset | Size | Description |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| `Game` | string | 8 | 50 | Telemetry origin identifier (`"G-Rebels"`). |
| `VehicleName` | string | 58 | 50 | Active spacecraft name (e.g. `"Razorback"`). |
| `Location` | string | 108 | 50 | Active sector / arena name. |
| `Pitch` | float | 160 | 4 | Craft pitch angle (-180..+180°). |
| `Roll` | float | 164 | 4 | Craft roll angle (-180..+180°). |
| `Yaw` | float | 168 | 4 | Craft yaw angle (-180..+180°). |
| `Speed` | float | 172 | 4 | Craft speed. |
| `LongitudinalAcc` | float | 176 | 4 | Longitudinal acceleration (Surge). |
| `LateralAcc` | float | 180 | 4 | Lateral acceleration (Sway). |
| `VerticalAcc` | float | 184 | 4 | Vertical acceleration (Heave). |
| `LateralVelocity` | float | 188 | 4 | Lateral strafe/drift velocity. |
| `VerticalVelocity` | float | 192 | 4 | Vertical climb/dive velocity. |
| `LongitudinalVelocity`| float | 196 | 4 | Forward/reverse velocity. |
| `ThrustMain` | float | 200 | 4 | Main forward/reverse thruster input (-1..+1). |
| `ThrustVertical` | float | 204 | 4 | Vertical thruster input (-1 down, +1 up). |
| `ThrustLateral` | float | 208 | 4 | Lateral strafe thruster input (-1 left, +1 right). |
| `PrimaryCount` | int32 | 212 | 4 | Cumulative cannon shots fired. |
| `SecondaryCount` | int32 | 216 | 4 | Cumulative missile releases. |
| `HitCount` | int32 | 220 | 4 | Cumulative incoming projectile hits taken. |
| `CollisionCount` | int32 | 224 | 4 | Cumulative physical collision impacts. |
| `HitStrength` | float | 228 | 4 | Damage energy rating of most recent projectile hit. |
| `CollisionStrength` | float | 232 | 4 | Physical collision contact force. |
| `ImpactDirX` | float | 236 | 4 | Native impact vector normal X (forward/rear). |
| `ImpactDirY` | float | 240 | 4 | Native impact vector normal Y (right/left). |
| `ImpactDirZ` | float | 244 | 4 | Native impact vector normal Z (up/down). |
| `BoostActive` | int32 | 248 | 4 | Binary boost state: `1` = active, `0` = inactive. |
| `BoostLevel` | float | 252 | 4 | Boost tank charge level (0.0 .. 1.0). |
| `Hull` | float | 256 | 4 | Hull structural integrity level (0.0 .. 1.0). |
| `Shield` | float | 260 | 4 | Shield energy capacity level (0.0 .. 1.0). |

## 5. Troubleshooting & FAQ

| Symptom | Cause | Action |
|---|---|---|
| No vital, weapon, or boost properties updating | In-game telemetry set to default `Sim Racing Studio` (SRS) profile | In *Options > Input > Peripherals > Telemetry*, switch **Output** from `Sim Racing Studio` to **`Expanded`**. |
| Connection fails or no packets received | Misconfigured IP address | Verify game telemetry IP is set to `127.0.0.1` (ignore `27.0.0.1` typo in Reakktor's published documentation). |
| Telemetry shows stale / 0 after exiting flight | Player returned to hangar or paused | Normal behavior: feed goes stale when game pauses UDP output. |

---

## 6. Pending Complete Telemetry Packet (264-Byte Stream)

The game binary (`G_Rebels-Win64-Shipping.exe`) defines both the legacy base telemetry packet (`TelemetryPacket`, 236 bytes) and the complete expanded structure (`TelemetryPacket2`, 264 bytes). In the current shipping release, the UDP socket outputs 236 bytes even when the in-game profile is set to `Expanded` (`TelemetryMode = 1`). 

The plugin is fully built, tested, and backward/forward compatible:
- **Packets < 264 bytes**: Safely parses the initial 236 bytes and gracefully zeroes the missing 7 fields.
- **Packets == 264 bytes**: Automatically ingests all 264 bytes without requiring any plugin updates or rebuilds.

### The 7 Missing Expanded Format Fields

The following 7 fields occupy offsets 236 through 263 (totaling 28 bytes) and will become active once Reakktor enables the 264-byte dispatch in an upcoming game update:

| Offset | Type | Game Variable | Plugin Property | Status in Current Build |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `236` | `float` (4B) | `last_impact_dir_x` | `GRebels.ImpactDirX` | Zeroed (defaults to `0.0`) |
| `240` | `float` (4B) | `last_impact_dir_y` | `GRebels.ImpactDirY` | Zeroed (defaults to `0.0`) |
| `244` | `float` (4B) | `last_impact_dir_z` | `GRebels.ImpactDirZ` | Zeroed (defaults to `0.0`) |
| `248` | `int32` (4B) | `boost_active` | `GRebels.BoostActive` | Zeroed (defaults to `0`) |
| `252` | `float` (4B) | `boost_level` | `GRebels.BoostLevel`, `GRebels.BoostPercent` | Zeroed (defaults to `0.0` / `0%`) |
| `256` | `float` (4B) | `hull` | `GRebels.Hull`, `GRebels.HullPercent` | Zeroed (defaults to `0.0` / `0%`) |
| `260` | `float` (4B) | `shield` | `GRebels.Shield`, `GRebels.ShieldPercent` | Zeroed (defaults to `0.0` / `0%`) |

> [!NOTE]
> All other properties—including `PrimaryCount`, `PrimaryFired`, `SecondaryCount`, `SecondaryFired`, `HitCount`, `HitStrength`, `HitFired`, `HitImpulse`, `CollisionCount`, `CollisionStrength`, `CollisionStrengthAbs`, `CollisionLastStrength`, `CollisionFired`, `CollisionImpulse`, and kinematic collision direction fallbacks—are located in the first 236 bytes and are **fully functional** in the current build.

### In-Game Validation Protocols Pending 264-Byte Update

The following 4 validation procedures are currently deferred awaiting the 264-byte stream update from Reakktor:

#### 1. Shield Vital Indicator & Depletion Protocol
- **Target Properties**: `GRebels.Shield`, `GRebels.ShieldPercent`
- **Current Behavior**: Both properties hold default value `0` / `0%`.
- **Validation Steps Upon 264-Byte Activation**:
  1. Launch into any active combat scenario (e.g., Sector C or training arena).
  2. Confirm `GRebels.Shield` reads `1.0` and `GRebels.ShieldPercent` reads `100` at initial spawn with full shields.
  3. Engage an enemy craft or static defense turret to take direct projectile hits.
  4. Verify that `GRebels.ShieldPercent` decrements in real time matching the in-cockpit shield ring display.
  5. Confirm `GRebels.HitFired` pulses to 100 and `GRebels.HitCount` / `GRebels.HitStrength` reflect each impact while shields absorb the damage.
  6. Disengage and verify shields regenerate back toward 100%.

#### 2. Hull Integrity & Cockpit Warning Protocol
- **Target Properties**: `GRebels.Hull`, `GRebels.HullPercent`
- **Current Behavior**: Both properties hold default value `0` / `0%`.
- **Validation Steps Upon 264-Byte Activation**:
  1. Confirm `GRebels.Hull` reads `1.0` and `GRebels.HullPercent` reads `100` when the craft is undamaged.
  2. Allow enemy fire or environmental hazards to completely deplete shields (`GRebels.ShieldPercent == 0`).
  3. Take subsequent projectile or collision damage.
  4. Verify `GRebels.HullPercent` drops below 100% proportionally to cockpit hull damage readouts.
  5. Verify HUD warning triggers (e.g. low-hull alerts) activate when `GRebels.HullPercent` crosses critical thresholds (< 25%).

#### 3. Afterburner / Boost System Protocol
- **Target Properties**: `GRebels.BoostActive`, `GRebels.BoostLevel`, `GRebels.BoostPercent`
- **Current Behavior**: `BoostActive` holds `0`, `BoostLevel` holds `0.0`, `BoostPercent` holds `0`.
- **Validation Steps Upon 264-Byte Activation**:
  1. While in flight, confirm `GRebels.BoostActive == 0` and `GRebels.BoostPercent == 100` (or starting tank level).
  2. Press and hold the boost key (`"C"` or gamepad boost button).
  3. Verify `GRebels.BoostActive` immediately transitions to `1`.
  4. Observe `GRebels.BoostLevel` (0.0 to 1.0) and `GRebels.BoostPercent` (0 to 100) depleting dynamically as long as boost is engaged.
  5. Release boost and verify `GRebels.BoostActive` returns to `0`.
  6. Verify `GRebels.BoostPercent` gradually charges back to 100% (or cooling/recharge curve).

#### 4. Native 3D Impact Normal Vectors Protocol
- **Target Properties**: `GRebels.ImpactDirX`, `GRebels.ImpactDirY`, `GRebels.ImpactDirZ`
- **Current Behavior**: Properties report `0.0`. Collision direction resolution currently utilizes the plugin's kinematic delta-V fallback (`GRebels.CollisionDirection` / `GRebels.CollisionDirectionCode`).
- **Validation Steps Upon 264-Byte Activation**:
  1. Collide with a stationary obstacle (e.g. asteroid, space station bulkhead, canyon wall) head-on.
  2. Confirm `ImpactDirX` / `ImpactDirY` / `ImpactDirZ` reflect the Unreal Engine `FHitResult.ImpactNormal` vector.
  3. Validate that frontal impacts yield positive X-axis normals, rear impacts negative X, lateral impacts ±Y, and vertical impacts ±Z.
  4. Verify that directional HUD arrows and haptic feedback orient accurately toward the native impact point.
